humanLessons.dilemma: Dream cannot proceed without human teaching on the authentic theme, materials, ink palette, and Tier 1-4 prop catalog for "forest".

resolution.description: Primeval temperate rainforest canopy with 3-strata verticality: Sunken Understory (0m-3.5m), Mid-Canopy Walkways (6.5m-8.5m), and Crown Swing Vantages (12m-18m). Features climbable spiral trunk stairs, hollow log sprint tunnels, suspension rope bridges, and 3D coniferous and weeping willow groves.

tier3_macro: towering ancient banyan with spiral trunk stairs
tier4_kinetic: momentum swing vines and rope rings

humanLessons.dilemma: Dream cannot proceed without human teaching on the authentic theme, materials, ink palette, and Tier 1-4 prop catalog for "station".
humanLessons.resolution: Theme: space_station. Archetype: space. Setting: Deep space orbital station, gravity centrifuge, airlocks, solar arrays, and communications dishes. Primary: INK.BLUE, Secondary: INK.BLACK, Accent: INK.ORANGE, Hazard: INK.RED. Tier 1: cryo pod, oxygen tank, holographic console, airlock hatch, hydroponic tray, meteor shield. Tier 2: solar panel wing, docking umbilical, centrifuge spoke, reactor core. Tier 3: command cupola dome, monolithic comms dish, centrifuge habitat wheel. Tier 4: circling orbital satellites, zero-G grapple highway.
